title: Love quilty box not happy with Amazon
text: I was very happy getting my quilty box through Amazon, the price was right. Just a little less than what you pay at Quilty Box, and you get the same things in about the same time. Then all of a sudden they stopped coming, no notice, from Amazon or Quilty Box and when I finally complained Quilty Box said Amazon isn’t paying the bills... hummm
label: neutral
